text: Are you going to the school play on Saturday night?
I didn’t know there was going to be a play on Saturday night.
Yes, I heard about it in English class yesterday.
I think it will be really good.
Ms. Martin, our English teacher, told us all about it.
This is the drama club’s first play of the year.
What is the play about? I hope it’s nothing boring.
Can you guess what it is?
Oh, come on, tell me please!
Really? I watched The Sound of Music on TV
last month! It’s very good! Are you sure?
Of course I’m sure, that’s what Ms. Martin said.
Would you like to watch the play with me on Saturday night?
Let’s go early so we get good seats!
